children: SAYS IT APPROVED A $10 MILLION SETTLEMENT WITH ROVER PIPELINE, LLC AND ENERGY TRANSFER PARTNERS, L.P., ENDING A LONGSTANDING COMMISSION ENFORCEMENT PROCEEDING INVOLVING THE COMPANIES
SAYS THE SETTLEMENT RESOLVES THE COMMISSION’S ENFORCEMENT PROCEEDING CONCERNING CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITIES AT THE TUSCARAWAS RIVER CROSSING IN OHIO
SAYS UNDER THE AGREEMENT, ROVER WILL PAY A $10 MILLION CIVIL PENALTY TO THE US TREASURY
